page.overview:
Who is Libushe?

Libushe (Polish: Libusze), or Libushka, was the wife of Caldemeyn (the alderman of Blaviken), and the mother of Marilka.

While her husband thoroughly enjoyed Geralt's company, Libushe didn't particularly like the witcher, believing he brought nothing but trouble. She also didn't like it very much when, on a past visit, Geralt tried to show off his witcher abilities by throwing a fork and killing a rat with it in complete darkness.
